answers.core:
I can't think of any reason this can't be an add-on, assuming it doesn't hinder integration compared to if this was core (I don't have actual experience with Godot Add-Ons yet).

If it's in the Asset Library, everyone looking up search terms to solve the problem of limiting the aspect ratio range of their Godot game to more than just 1 aspect ratios would find it just as easily as they would instructions on how to do this in the Base Godot engine if this was core.

However, I think this might be a common problem especially for beginners, so it should still be considered
if it's a good idea to make this core instead.
